lines.text: Hi there, and karibu! I'm Kwamboka.
lines.say: hˈaɪ ðˈɛɹ, ænd kɑːɾˈiːbuː! aɪm kwɑːmbˈɔːkɑː.

lines.text: I'll be your guide to Hatua.
lines.say: aɪl biː jʊɹ ɡˈaɪd tə hɑːtˈuːɑː.

lines.text: Give me two minutes, and I'll walk you through it, step by step.
lines.say: ɡˈɪv mˌiː tˈuː mˈɪnɪts, ænd aɪl wˈɔːk juː θɹˈuː ɪt, stˈɛp baɪ stˈɛp.

lines.text: Let's start by signing in.
lines.say: lˈɛts stˈɑːɹt baɪ sˈaɪnɪŋ ˈɪn.

lines.text: You're a teacher, so leave it on: I am a teacher.
lines.say: jʊɹ ɐ tˈiːtʃɚ, sˌoʊ lˈiːv ɪɾ ˈɔn: aɪɐm ɐ tˈiːtʃɚ.

lines.text: Type your member number, then your PIN, and press Sign in.
lines.say: tˈaɪp jʊɹ mˈɛmbɚ nˈʌmbɚ, ðˈɛn jʊɹ pˈɪn, ænd pɹˈɛs sˈaɪn ˈɪn.

lines.text: This is your Today page.
lines.say: ðɪs ɪz jʊɹ tədˈeɪ pˈeɪdʒ.

lines.text: It tells you what needs you right now.
lines.say: ɪt tˈɛlz juː wʌt nˈiːdz juː ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ.

lines.text: Look, the Term 3 results are waiting for you to check.
lines.say: lˈʊk, ðə tˈɜːm θɹˈiː ɹɪzˈʌlts ɑːɹ wˈeɪɾɪŋ fɔːɹ juː tə tʃˈɛk.

lines.text: So let's check them. Press Check the file.
lines.say: sˌoʊ lˈɛts tʃˈɛk ðˌɛm. pɹˈɛs tʃˈɛk ðə fˈaɪl.

lines.text: Hatua shows you what's inside, before anything is saved.
lines.say: hɑːtˈuːɑː ʃˈoʊz juː wʌts ɪnsˈaɪd, bᵻfˌɔːɹ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ɪz sˈeɪvd.

lines.text: Happy with it? Press Approve.
lines.say: hˈæpi wɪð ɪt? pɹˈɛs ɐpɹˈuːv.

lines.text: Nothing gets into Hatua until you say so.
lines.say: nˈʌθɪŋ ɡˈɛts ˌɪntʊ hɑːtˈuːɑː ʌntˈɪl juː sˈeɪ sˈoʊ.

lines.text: Now, back to Today.
lines.say: nˈaʊ, bˈæk tə tədˈeɪ.

lines.text: Hatua has spotted two learners who need a closer look.
lines.say: hɑːtˈuːɑː hɐz spˈɑːɾᵻd tˈuː lˈɜːnɚz hˌuː nˈiːd ɐ klˈoʊsɚ lˈʊk.

lines.text: Let's open Kamau.
lines.say: lˈɛts ˈoʊpən kɑːmˈɑːuː.

lines.text: Here's Kamau's story, all the way from Grade 4.
lines.say: hˈɪɹz kɑːmˈɑːuːz stˈɔːɹi, ˈɔːl ðə wˈeɪ fɹʌm ɡɹˈeɪd fˈɔːɹ.

lines.text: We call it the long view.
lines.say: wiː kˈɔːl ɪt ðə lˈɔŋ vjˈuː.

lines.text: Tap any mark, and you'll see the record behind it.
lines.say: tˈæp ˌɛni mˈɑːɹk, ænd juːl sˈiː ðə ɹˈɛkɚd bᵻhˈaɪnd ɪt.

lines.text: Report time? Press Write a comment.
lines.say: ɹᵻpˈɔːɹt tˈaɪm? pɹˈɛs ɹˈaɪt ɐ kˈɑːmɛnt.

lines.text: Hatua drafts one for you, from Kamau's records.
lines.say: hɑːtˈuːɑː dɹˈæfts wˈʌn fɔːɹ juː, fɹʌm kɑːmˈɑːuːz ɹˈɛkɚdz.

lines.text: You're the teacher, so you decide. If it sounds right, give it a thumbs up.
lines.say: jʊɹ ðə tˈiːtʃɚ, sˌoʊ juː dᵻsˈaɪd. ɪf ɪt sˈaʊndz ɹˈaɪt, ɡˈɪv ɪɾ ɐ θˈʌmz ˈʌp.

lines.text: Want to tell Kamau's parent? Press Message the parent.
lines.say: wˈɔnt tə tˈɛl kɑːmˈɑːuːz pˈɛɹənt? pɹˈɛs mˈɛsɪdʒ ðə pˈɛɹənt.

lines.text: Read the words, and change anything you like.
lines.say: ɹˈiːd ðə wˈɜːdz, ænd tʃˈeɪndʒ ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ juː lˈaɪk.

lines.text: Type the parent's WhatsApp number, tick the box, and you're ready to send it yourself.
lines.say: tˈaɪp ðə pˈɛɹənts wʌts ˈæp nˈʌmbɚ, tˈɪk ðə bˈɑːks, ænd jʊɹ ɹˈɛdi tə sˈɛnd ɪt jɔːɹsˈɛlf.

lines.text: You press Send, in your own WhatsApp.
lines.say: juː pɹˈɛs sˈɛnd, ɪn jʊɹ ˈoʊn wʌts ˈæp.

lines.text: Parents can have their own sign-in, too.
lines.say: pˈɛɹənts kæn hæv ðɛɹ ˈoʊn sˈaɪnˈɪn, tˈuː.

lines.text: Press Give a parent access, and type the parent's name.
lines.say: pɹˈɛs ɡˈɪv ɐ pˈɛɹənt ˈæksɛs, ænd tˈaɪp ðə pˈɛɹənts nˈeɪm.

lines.text: Hatua makes a parent number and a one-time PIN. Print the slip, and hand it over.
lines.say: hɑːtˈuːɑː mˌeɪks ɐ pˈɛɹənt nˈʌmbɚ ænd ɐ wˈʌntˈaɪm pˈɪn. pɹˈɪnt ðə slˈɪp, ænd hˈænd ɪɾ ˈoʊvɚ.

lines.text: Got a question? Just ask the Hatua assistant.
lines.say: ɡɑːt ɐ kwˈɛstʃən? dʒˈʌst ˈæsk ðə hɑːtˈuːɑː ɐsˈɪstənt.

lines.text: It asks you one quick question first, so the answer fits what you need.
lines.say: ɪɾ ˈæsks juː wˈʌn kwˈɪk kwˈɛstʃən fˈɜːst, sˌoʊ ðɪ ˈænsɚ fˈɪts wʌt juː nˈiːd.

lines.text: And it will never rank your learners.
lines.say: ænd ɪt wɪl nˈɛvɚ ɹˈæŋk jʊɹ lˈɜːnɚz.

lines.text: One last thing. In My account, you can switch between light and dark.
lines.say: wˈʌn lˈæst θˈɪŋ. ɪn maɪ ɐkˈaʊnt, juː kæn swˈɪtʃ bᵻtwˌiːn lˈaɪt ænd dˈɑːɹk.

lines.text: And if you ever get stuck, the Help button has the full guide.
lines.say: ænd ɪf juː ˈɛvɚ ɡɛt stˈʌk, ðə hˈɛlp bˈʌʔn hɐz ðə fˈʊl ɡˈaɪd.

scenes.title: You are ready

lines.text: And that's Hatua.
lines.say: ænd ðæts hɑːtˈuːɑː.

lines.text: You stay in charge, step by step.
lines.say: juː stˈeɪ ɪn tʃˈɑːɹdʒ, stˈɛp baɪ stˈɛp.

lines.text: Asante sana, and all the best with your class!
lines.say: ɑːsˈɑːntɛ sˈɑːnɑː, ænd ˈɔːl ðə bˈɛst wɪð jʊɹ klˈæs!

scenes.sub: You stay in charge, step by step
